title: A real grandson asking for concert money
description: The user's grandson calls from his own number to chat, then asks for $40 on PayPal as they had agreed. Low risk: the payment waits for the call to end, then goes through.

lines.text: Hey Grandma, it's Jake. How are you feeling today?
I passed my driving test this morning, first try.
Mom says we're all coming over for dinner on Sunday.
Oh, and could you send me forty dollars on PayPal for the concert tickets, like we talked about?
No rush at all. Love you, see you Sunday!
